gaps.sentence: She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.

gaps.sentence: She keyed ___ the password and logged on.
gaps.explanation: key in = type in (a password, code).

gaps.sentence: Let's start ___ — the first version had too many errors.
gaps.explanation: start over = begin again from the beginning.

gaps.sentence: The car broke ___ on the motorway.
Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.

gaps.sentence: The new manager wants to back ___ the sales team's proposal.
gaps.explanation: back up = support (a person, plan); also make a copy of data.
